# AEGIFLOW — AI Automation, Custom Software & Security by Design

> AEGIFLOW is an engineering firm specialized in Custom Artificial Intelligence Integration (AI Agents & LLMs), Complex Workflow Automation (APIs & Workflows), Full-Stack Software Development (Web, Mobile & PC/Desktop), and Native Cybersecurity (Security by Design). Founded by Ousmane Barry, AEGIFLOW empowers SMEs, agencies, and enterprises across France, Spain, the European Union, and internationally.

## Identity & Core Positioning

- **Official Name:** AEGIFLOW
- **Tagline / Slogan:** Automate Smarter. Secure by Design.
- **Official Website:** https://www.aegiflow.eu
- **Founder:** Ousmane Barry (Cybersecurity Specialist, AI Engineer & Software Developer)
- **Service Areas:** France, Spain, European Union & International
- **Working Languages:** English (EN), French (FR), Spanish (ES)
- **Official Contact:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/ousmane-barry and secure contact form at https://www.aegiflow.eu/#contact

## Key Performance Indicators & Authority (Track Record)

- **Experience:** 8+ years of combined expertise (Cybersecurity, Software Engineering & AI)
- **Delivered Projects:** 40+ completed and deployed enterprise systems
- **Client Satisfaction:** 98.7% verified satisfaction rate
- **Reliability:** 99.4% on-time milestone delivery

---

## Core Pillars of Expertise

### 1. Custom AI Agents & LLMs (AI Engineering)
- Architecture and deployment of autonomous multi-agent systems tailored to business operations.
- Secure, API-driven private Large Language Model (LLM) integration.
- Automated document triage, extraction, and synthesis (contracts, invoices, support emails, internal knowledge bases).
- Isolated, private AI architectures: zero data leakage to public third-party models.

### 2. Automation & Software Engineering (Web, Mobile & PC)
- Complex workflow automation and deep tool interconnection (CRM, ERP, SQL/NoSQL databases, webhooks, and REST/GraphQL APIs).
- Custom full-stack development for modern Web applications, Mobile apps (iOS & Android), and PC Desktop software.
- Elimination of repetitive manual tasks and consolidation of business processes into unified platforms.

### 3. Security by Design & Offensive/Defensive Cybersecurity
- Strict protection and encryption of API keys, webhooks, secrets, and environment variables.
- Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and sensitive data segregation.
- Deep expertise rooted in offensive cybersecurity: Penetration Testing (Web, APIs, Active Directory, Linux/Windows environments), EDR/AV evasion mitigation, infrastructure hardening, and active defense.
- Rigorous vulnerability assessment and hardening prior to every production release.

---

## Real-World Use Cases Deployed by AEGIFLOW

1. **AI Document Triage & Structured Extraction (Zero Leakage):** Automated processing of contracts, invoices, and emails by a private AI agent, extracting structured data and injecting it directly into the client's CRM/ERP.
2. **Internal Assistants & Multi-Agent Systems:** AI agents connected to proprietary knowledge bases and corporate tools, enforcing strict access controls matching each employee's role.
3. **Client Acquisition Pipelines & Custom Portals:** Complete automation from inbound lead qualification to client onboarding, including custom Web, Mobile, or PC portal development and automated follow-ups.

---

## Engagement Formats (Offerings)

- **Phase 01 — Flash Audit & First Workflow (Quick Win):** Process mapping, API security verification, and rapid turnkey delivery of a first automated pipeline.
- **Phase 02 — AI & Software Ecosystem (Full Solution):** End-to-end design, implementation, and deployment of custom AI agents, automated workflows, and software under a Security by Design architecture, complete with technical documentation and team training.
- **Phase 03 — Continuous Scale & Security (Ongoing Partnership):** Monthly optimization, AI model updates, API connector maintenance, regular security audits, and priority engineering support.

---

## Market Differentiation (Why AEGIFLOW?)

Unlike typical automation agencies that stitch together fragile no-code tools and expose sensitive API keys or client data to unisolated public models, **AEGIFLOW** applies offensive and defensive cybersecurity standards (**Security by Design**) to every line of code, workflow, and AI agent.
